Chapter 01 / 06 — What is flow?

Mission: ONENESS

[ˈwən-nəs] noun

1. the fact or state of being unified or whole, though comprised of two or more parts. Connection with ourselves, our neighbors, and the natural world.

The way that we do this is through places and spaces. We design communities that foster oneness to allow you to live your life in Flow.

Chapter 05 / 06 — flow × CMPLX

Your Space,
Our Shared Values.

CMPLX have curated a space that aligns with Flow's values — food, wellness, community and craft, gathered around one courtyard. We want to be an integral part of CMPLX's success. This site proposes a few ways Flow can work with CMPLX.

Shared value 01
F&B

CMPLX: restaurants, roastery, confirmed culinary names. Flow: grocer, café, market — the everyday food layer.

Shared value 02
Wellness

CMPLX: studios and wellness concepts. Flow: a residential brand built on wellbeing — peace is the practice.

Shared value 03
Community

CMPLX: a courtyard built for gathering. Flow: the team that programmes gatherings, weekly, on two continents.

Chapter 06 / 06 — How we imagine the space

An experience centre for Flow.
A home for the CMPLX community.

We want to create an experience centre for our brand — and make the CMPLX community feel at home, with a small internal Flow workspace on the mezzanine. We propose two ways to make this happen:

AOption A — flow grocer, downstairs

The neighbourhood grocer
Dubai comes back for.

A curated market in the double-height volume — produce walls, pantry, prepared food, local makers, a café counter. Already operating in Miami; at CMPLX it becomes the district's daily anchor and the farmers market spills into the courtyard.

Daily.
Repeat footfall, not occasions

+With either option — flow farmers market

Footfall you can
set your watch by.

Whichever way the ground floor goes, the courtyard gets the Flow Farmers Market: a weekly gathering of growers, makers, coffee and music that we already run in Brickell. It turns first-time visitors into regulars — and lands footfall on every CMPLX tenant, every week, from opening day.

Weekly.
A ritual, not a one-off activation
Every tenant.

BOption B — workflow, downstairs

The workspace where
the district gets to work.

WorkFlow fills the volume: hospitality-grade workspace for Al Quoz's creatives and founders — desks, studios, a coffee bar, Flow programming after hours. The double-height glazing becomes the most inspiring room in the district, and CMPLX gains a weekday population.
